Miracly: Spektrum Painting case study m ı racly How it works Pricing Case studies Free tools Partners Careers Case study: Spektrum Painting, Gothenburg 1,140 pages and 221K impressions in 90 days. A Swedish painting company went from 5 indexed pages to 1,140, without paid advertising. Here is what Miracly built and what Search Console measured. 221 K Impressions +97% in 90 days 1,010 Clicks +96% in 90 days 1,140 Indexed pages up from 5 99 % Non-branded traffic entirely new audience Timeline: 12 February to 11 May 2026 Source: Google Search Console Paid media: none Impressions, weekly From near zero to 221K in one quarter. Pages that didn’t exist 90 days ago now drive qualified traffic. Four of the five top pages had zero clicks before Miracly. The traffic is incremental, not cannibalized from pages that already ranked. 99 percent of it is non-branded, meaning people who had never heard of Spektrum.
